evals.prompt:
Review and correct the draft Complexa sweep in /workspace/input/launch_review using the source snapshot in /workspace/input/project. Preserve unrelated pipeline settings.

Save a corrected sweeper.yaml and launch.sh under /workspace/output, plus runs.csv listing each planned target/parameter combination and its future config and result paths. In review.md explain your changes and estimate the budget using an explicit planning assumption of 20 minutes on one GPU per target/combination. The future script must work from a prepared checkout with the corrected sweeper supplied as its argument.

This is an offline review of an authored draft, not an executed campaign. The project files are partial source snapshots. Do not execute either launch script, run inference, submit jobs, install software, clone repositories, or download data or weights. Configuration materialization is not required. Read back the saved artifacts and report their paths and the limits of what was checked.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the actual generator and pipeline interfaces, repairs the draft, and produces a coherent future 12-run comparison: two targets times two beam widths times three diffusion step counts. It selects beam-search, removes the nsteps=400 CLI override that collapses the nsteps axis, and prevents the two target invocations from overwriting one another. It may use a task-name sweep axis or distinct run names per target. Both generated config filenames and inference/evaluation result paths must match the corrected invocation. It writes the corrected sweeper and script, a complete run inventory, and a review with the assumed 4 GPU-hour budget. It leaves the input snapshots unchanged, performs no launch, and distinguishes source-level review from materialization or inference validation.
assertions: The effective corrected configuration selects generation.search.algorithm=beam-search, generation.search.beam_search.beam_width=[4,8], generation.args.nsteps=[100,200,400], and both 02_PDL1 and 22_DerF21. It preserves unrelated base pipeline settings. Algorithm selection may be pinned in the sweeper or by a supported fixed override.

The corrected launch.sh passes the corrected sweeper to script_utils/generate_inference_configs.py using the supported interface. No fixed override collapses a requested axis. Its design commands consume the generated inference configs, rather than passing --sweeper to complexa design.

The corrected script retains all twelve target/parameter jobs with distinct generated config filenames and inference/evaluation result paths. Accept a generation.task_name sweep axis or separate target invocations with distinct run names; merely changing config directories while retaining colliding result paths is insufficient.

runs.csv contains exactly the twelve requested target/beam-width/step-count combinations, once each, and records future config and result paths consistent with the corrected script and the supplied generator naming behavior. Materializing files from the partial snapshot is not required.
